prompt: How does res.send decide the Content-Type and the ETag of a response? Answer with the files and functions involved. Do not modify the repository.
notes: E2 navigation. Facts verified by grep at the pinned commit on 2026-11-09, before any agent run. res.send (lib/response.js:126) sets Content-Type per chunk type (setCharset for strings, this.type('bin'/'json')), then generates the ETag through app.get('etag fn') when no ETag header exists.
